verdict.rationale: The evidence shows mParticle has its own client SDKs. They set an environment flag in a documented Events API batch format, which has a published OpenAPI spec, and IDSync provides identity management across apps and platforms. That is a real first-party collection layer with a documented event schema. However, the pack never lists which platforms the SDKs cover or describes a track/identify/page call model, so most of the story is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit web, mobile and server SDK coverage; a documented track/identify/page (or equivalent) tracking spec; SDK-level docs beyond a title; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can collect events from web, mobile, and server apps through official SDKs that implement a documented tracking spec (track, identify, page)
